## README.md
# GEBCO 2025 Global Seafloor Bathymetry

Global terrain model for ocean and land at 15 arc-second intervals (~450m at equator). Sub-ice topography variant — includes bathymetry beneath the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets. Values are in metres relative to mean sea level; negative = ocean depth, positive = land elevation.

**Source:** [GEBCO 2025 Gridded Bathymetry Data](https://www.gebco.net/data-products/gridded-bathymetry-data/)  
**License:** [GEBCO Data Licence](https://www.gebco.net/data-products/gridded-bathymetry-data/#licence) — free to use with attribution  
**Citation:** GEBCO Compilation Group (2025) GEBCO 2025 Grid (doi:10.5285/8896b933-5744-4bdf-862b-43a76c3f91a8)

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `gebco-2025-cog.tif` | Cloud-optimized GeoTIFF, 15 arc-sec, EPSG:4326, ~3.3 GB |
| `gebco-2025/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` | H3 resolution 8 hex parquet, mean elevation per cell |

## DuckDB Example

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- Sample bathymetry near the Mariana Trench (h0 cell covering NW Pacific)
SELECT
  h8,
  elevation as depth_m,
  h3_cell_to_lat(h8) as lat,
  h3_cell_to_lng(h8) as lng
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-high-seas/gebco-2025/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
WHERE elevation < -8000
ORDER BY elevation
LIMIT 10;

-- Depth distribution in the high seas (< -200m)
SELECT
  FLOOR(elevation / 1000) * 1000 as depth_bin,
  COUNT(*) as n_cells
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-high-seas/gebco-2025/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
WHERE elevation < -200
GROUP BY depth_bin
ORDER BY depth_bin;
```

## TiTiler / MapLibre Example

The COG can be visualized via TiTiler:

```
https://titiler.xyz/cog/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
  ?url=https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-high-seas/gebco-2025-cog.tif
  &colormap_name=blues_r
  &rescale=-6000,0
```

```javascript
map.addSource('gebco', {
  type: 'raster',
  tiles: [
    'https://titiler.xyz/cog/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png' +
    '?url=https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-high-seas/gebco-2025-cog.tif' +
    '&colormap_name=blues_r&rescale=-6000,0'
  ],
  tileSize: 256
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'gebco-bathymetry',
  type: 'raster',
  source: 'gebco'
});
```
